model.name: R20.16: Test node in the chain displays its test-case STATUS (pass/fail badge).
model.description: The TEST node in a /trace chain MUST display its test-case STATUS as a visible badge — pass (green ✓) or fail (red ✗) with the result count (e.g. '5/5 PASS'). Currently the Test node shows only its name with no status indication. The status data comes from the Test scenario unit's model (last-run result, or live vitest output). Screenshot evidence: test-status-IMG_4040.png.
model.tronQuote: > TRON: "i want to see the test case status on the test"

intendedChain.useCase: testNode.showStatus — Test node in /trace renders pass/fail badge from test result data
intendedChain.method: renderTestStatus — read model.lastResult (pass/fail/count), render badge (green ✓ / red ✗ + count)
intendedChain.test: RED: expand chain to Test node (e.g. 4644dd3c drawer-champagne) → assert visible pass/fail badge with count. Currently FAILS (no status shown, just name).
